recipes.name: Run 1

steps.title: Take the stock
steps.text: Take a wedge (1/8 of a log) stick at least 72.94 in long. Write 1 on it in chalk. It is longer than a 72 in stick: splice two, or cut it from a longer log.

steps.title: Rip it flush
steps.text: This piece stands taller than the frame. Rip 1.43 in off the bark side, parallel to the stick's length, so it sits flush with both faces of the panel. Lay it on a sawn face on the bandsaw or table saw; tilt the blade 22.50° (half the slice's angle) so the cut runs square to the slice's centre line.

steps.title: Cut 1 (first end) on the mitre saw
steps.text: Lay the stick on the ripped face on the saw table, with the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face against the fence, the keeper to the LEFT of the blade. Mitre 34.4° — followed from the fence toward you, the cut drifts to the RIGHT. Bevel 45.0° — top of the blade tilted to the LEFT. Slide it so the blade just clears the raw end everywhere -- about 0.5 in in from the end at its longest. The offcut, right of the blade, is a tapered piece: 6.85 in along the point, down to 0.50 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face. This cut meets the frame's 45° wall.

steps.title: Cut 2 (second end) on the mitre saw
steps.text: Lay the stick on the ripped face on the saw table, with the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face against the fence, the keeper to the LEFT of the blade. Mitre 34.4° — followed from the fence toward you, the cut drifts to the LEFT. Bevel 45.0° — top of the blade tilted to the LEFT. Measure from the first cut and mark: 59.49 in along the point; 72.19 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face; 67.37 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face. Join the marks across the ripped face -- the blade follows that line. The offcut, right of the blade, is a tapered piece: 5.66 in along the point, down to 1.72 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face. This cut meets the frame's 45° wall.

steps.title: Check it
steps.text: Finished: 72.19 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face, 67.37 in along the corner between the ripped face and the slanted sawn face, 59.49 in along the point. Measure each against the list before it goes in.

steps.title: Put it in
steps.text: It goes in as run 1: standing on its point, bark toward the open side.
